items.statement: Nvme::run initializes inventory and constructs a callback bound to Nvme::read before entering the timer-restart block.
Each poll samples presence and power-good, handles absence first, applies the present-but-unpowered LED and inventory state, then reads data and updates sensor availability.
A non-present drive is cleared and removed before power-good handling, so the present-but-unpowered branch runs only when the presence signal is asserted.
The first present-but-unpowered sample logs and sets isErrorPower for the drive; a later power-good sample clears that latch.
GPIO sampling opens the configured value path, seeks to its start, extracts one value, retries after exceptions up to three times, then closes the stream.
A serial-number change publishes the inventory, asset, and DriveLifeUsed values and then updates the per-bus serial cache as one guarded transaction.
A StatusFlags change publishes the sampled value and then updates the per-bus status-flags cache as one guarded transaction.
A smart-warning change publishes SmartWarnings and its derived fault values and then updates the per-bus smart-warning cache as one guarded transaction.
A fault LED property write is suppressed while the locate LED group is asserted.
The physical locate LED controller is written only while the locate LED group is not asserted.
run constructs a read-bound callback, restarts _timer at monitorIntervalSec, and catches and logs restart exceptions.
Present-but-unpowered drives request fault on and locate off, latch one power error, and clear that latch when power-good returns.
setNvmeInventoryProperties writes Present, manufacturer, serial, model, and drive-life fields only when the sampled serial differs from the bus's cached serial, then refreshes that cache.
items.description: Inventory Present and asset properties are written only when the sampled serial differs from the cached serial, after which the cached serial is updated.
